Use it when you can see the problem coming and the order is disarmed.

Every crew on the far side is inside its return window and walking back. You can disarm this order from the facilities pane if you would rather decide each time yourself.

LanguageData.RR_Integration_Heading: Optional mods this company has a position on: {0} of {1} loaded
LanguageData.RR_Integration_Caveat: None of these has been tested in play. Loaded means present, not proven.
LanguageData.RR_Integration_VehicleFrameworkPosition: Nothing here needs a vehicle: a gate is opened on foot and a crew walks through it. With it loaded, the company vehicles section opens its own cargo and caravan screens for vehicles at a company site. Vehicles never go through a gate.
LanguageData.RR_Integration_RimWorldTogetherPosition: Each player runs their own company: their own facility, their own gate, their own discoveries, their own research and their own books. Visits and supply exchange are the other mod's features and work as it makes them work. There is no shared map and no shared research, and that mod carries no company records. Branches swap signed dossier files instead, outside it, and a dossier is read-only on arrival.
LanguageData.RR_Integration_GravshipOnePosition: Orbital travel is a separate way to get about and stays that way. Its air, fuel, power, heat and crew systems are untouched. A gate remains the only way into the Backrooms. Nothing here changes a gravship; the company vehicles section only selects a company site's grav engine so its own launch is in front of you.
LanguageData.RR_Integration_VehiclesExpandedPosition: Use its vehicles for whatever you like - staging a team, moving stock, carrying somebody home. None of it is required and none of it is changed here.
LanguageData.RR_Integration_GravshipTwoPosition: Its orbital combat, contracts and salvage are its own and are not patched. Nothing it fights will ever turn up in a Backrooms space: what lives in there is drawn only from this mod's own list of inhabitants, and that is checked on every build.
LanguageData.RR_Vehicle_Detail: These open the vehicle mod's own screens. Vehicles carry stock and crews between company sites over the world map; the gate is entered on foot.
